milestones.rejection_reason: The agreement has been rejected as our automated title verification system, along with utility bill, indicates that the property address is "10402 W HIDDEN LAKE LN B," while the agreement lists it as "10402 W HIDDEN LAKE LN."In accordance with our Underwriting Policy, the property address on the agreement must match exactly as it appears on the title verification.Please submit a Homeowner Change Order to correct this discrepancy and submit the signed change order to the customer’s agreement Drop File for review.For further information, please refer to the following article: SE-0001 Underwriting Policy.

milestones.label: Utility Bill
milestones.rejection_reason: The submitted utility bill has been rejected because the consumption on the utility bill is showing as 0 kWh. Please resubmit a complete utility bill that displays actual usage along with the following required information:Service addressDate (within the last 3 months)Account numberMeter numberConsumption (kWh)ESI ID numberAdditionally, please ensure that the consumption profile aligns with the 120% offset ceiling.For further information, please refer to the following article: SUBMISSION - UTILITY BILL - Texas (TX) Only – Solrite Energy Partner Help Center

milestones.label: Welcome Call
milestones.rejection_reason: The verification call will remain as rejected until the discrepancy with the Agreement is corrected.Once the discrepancy has been addressed, we will proceed with the approval of the verification call.For further information, please refer to the following article: SUBMISSION - Welcome (Verification) Call – Solrite Energy Partner Help Center

Please reconcile this discrepancy and update the documentation accordingly. Per manufacturer confirmation, the battery system must be derated to 5.76 kW, resulting in a total PCS current setting of 72 A. Update the plans and labeling details to reflect this requirement.The PV module specification sheet included in the planset does not correspond with the modules specified in the system design. job_stage.description: Congratulations! Your solar project has moved into the Permitting stage. Now that we have your approved design, we are going through your local building jurisdiction for permitting.

job_stage.name: Installation
job_stage.description: Congratulations! Your solar project has moved into the Installation stage. One of our team members will be reaching out to schedule your installation. Most installations take less than a full day to complete.

job_stage.name: Inspection
job_stage.description: Congratulations! Your solar has been installed. The utility company and local building jurisdiction will now come out for an inspection of your solar system.

job_stage.name: PTO
job_stage.description: Congratulations! Your project is almost complete. Now that your system has passed inspection, your utility company will give you the green light to turn your system on. To learn more about the process.
